clue.text: In horse-drawn vehicle heading south-east I travel wearily

indicators.note: the letter I is placed in the middle of the vehicle word, so 'In' signals one piece going inside another

parts.note: a trap is a light two-wheeled carriage pulled by a horse
SE is the compass abbreviation for south-east

explanation.surface: A weary traveller rides in a horse-drawn cart heading south-east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading' is just a link joining the vehicle to the direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to traipse is to walk or trudge along tiredly and reluctantly.

clue.text: Hybrid fruit with sharp taste the Spanish love

parts.note: a tang is a sharp, strong flavour
el is the Spanish word for 'the'
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A citrus fruit with a sharp flavour that Spaniards adore.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a tangelo is a cross between a tangerine and a pomelo or grapefruit.

clue.text: Law officer developing a tolerant energy

indicators.note: something developing is changing its form, so these letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A lawyer is becoming more tolerant and full of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Example of a role: the chief legal adviser to the government is a senior law officer of the Crown.

clue.text: Copy bureau's hard work crushed by signs of burglars

indicators.note: in a down clue a piece crushed by another sits underneath it, so the burglars' signs come first

parts.note: fingerprints left at a crime scene are prints
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard
OP is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: A copying office's toil is overwhelmed by evidence of break-ins.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's' after 'bureau' stands for 'is' and links definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a business producing printed copies is a copying bureau.

clue.text: Stethoscope shows distinctive character

indicators.note: the clue word displays the answer within its letters, so 'shows' marks a run of letters to pick out

explanation.surface: A doctor's listening instrument reveals a person's distinct nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the characteristic spirit or values of a group or person is their distinctive character.

clue.text: Get sick with having skate around track

indicators.note: the fish word wraps itself around the other letters, so 'around' signals a container

parts.note: a skate is a type of ray, the flat fish
to ail is to be unwell

explanation.surface: Someone feels ill after an ice-skate session around a rink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having' is a link word; the fish surrounds both the ailment and the W.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a line of rails for trains is a track.

clue.text: One contributes tax in settlement of a rare type

indicators.note: a settlement puts things in order, so these letters are rearranged and settled into new positions

explanation.surface: Someone paying tax as part of an unusual kind of financial settlement.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a person paying local property taxes (rates, in Britain) is a contributor of tax.

clue.text: Good shot at archery champion's missed initially

indicators.note: the champion word has its opening letter missing, so the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a champion is a winner

explanation.surface: A champion archer's good shot went astray at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's' after 'champion' stands for 'is' and links the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Archery term: the ring just around the bullseye on a target, and a hit there, is called by this name.

clue.text: Famous painting referee put out

parts.note: a referee blows a whistle, so is jokingly a whistler
to smother a fire is to put it out

explanation.surface: A referee is sent off in a famous picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: James McNeill Whistler's portrait of his mother is one of the most famous American paintings.

clue.text: Dairy products turn up in Mongolian tents

indicators.note: the reversed word is placed inside the tents, so 'in' signals the container

parts.note: yurts are the round felt tents of Mongolian nomads

indicators.note: in a down clue 'up' means the word turn's synonym is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: Yoghurt-making families in Mongolian tents arrive with their wares.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: fermented milk products are dairy products.

clue.text: However like an all-seater stadium

definitions.meaning: read as three words, it describes a ground with no standing room, only seats

explanation.surface: A double definition, the second a playful description of a modern football ground.
explanation.walkthrough: All-seater stadiums, now standard in British top-flight football, have no terraces for standing fans.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the preposition-adverb means despite this, just as however does.

clue.text: Bird shows remorse losing head

indicators.note: the remorse word loses its first letter, its head

parts.note: to regret is to show remorse

explanation.surface: A bird appears sorry after being decapitated.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the egret is a white wading heron.

clue.text: Very famous person's drink leading to arrest in commotion

parts.note: to sup is to drink, and a sup is a mouthful

indicators.note: a commotion is a disturbance, so the letters of arrest are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A celebrity's drinking ends in an arrest amid a disturbance.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's' after 'person' stands for 'has'; 'leading to' just joins the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an extremely famous performer or celebrity is a very famous person.

clue.text: Public boxing has first of youngsters being too impulsive

indicators.note: the public word encloses the others as a box would, so 'boxing' signals a container

parts.note: overt means open and public

indicators.note: only the opening letter of youngsters is taken

explanation.surface: Public boxing appeals to young people who act rashly.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: acting with excessive haste is being too impulsive.

clue.text: Sedative — placatory item given by mouth mostly

parts.note: a sop is something given to pacify or appease

indicators.note: most but not all of the mouth word is used, so its last letter is cut

parts.note: an orifice is an opening such as a mouth

explanation.surface: A sedative is a calming pill taken orally, more or less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given by' is a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a drug that induces sleep is a sedative; the word works as noun and adjective.

clue.text: Bishop with not so much to be thankful for

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
less means a smaller amount

explanation.surface: A bishop counts his blessings despite having less.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb sense: to feel grateful for something, as in 'I bless the day we met'.

clue.text: Unconventional people bemoan his undoing

indicators.note: undoing something takes it apart, so these letters are unpicked and rearranged

explanation.surface: Free spirits lament a man's downfall.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: artistic people who live outside social norms are unconventional types.

clue.text: Telephone number unknown lost? Make temporary arrangement

indicators.note: the phone word has something lost from it, so letters are taken out

parts.note: to ring up is to telephone
n stands for an unknown number in algebra

explanation.surface: Someone calls about a lost number and makes do with an interim plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb: to set up something makeshift is to make a temporary arrangement.

clue.text: Towered over short American friend, one with potential to bloom

parts.note: rose means rose up high, towered
bud is short for buddy, an American word for friend

explanation.surface: A short American buddy is dwarfed by a taller figure who might yet blossom.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: an unopened flower bud promises to bloom later.

clue.text: Punter's happy sound about horse race

indicators.note: the happy sound goes about the race, enclosing it

parts.note: a purr is the contented sound of a cat
a chase, or steeplechase, is a horse race over fences

explanation.surface: A betting man cheers as his horse wins the race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Punter's' stands for 'punter is'. 'Punter' suggests a gambler, but here it is a customer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: in British slang a punter is a customer or buyer.

clue.text: Holiday places men found in periods off work

indicators.note: the men are found inside the work-break word, so 'found in' signals one piece placed inside another

parts.note: rests are breaks from work
OR, other ranks, is the military abbreviation for ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Workers on leave flock to holiday destinations.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: popular vacation destinations are holiday places.

clue.text: Flighty vocalists

parts.note: flighty suggests fickle singers but literally means able to fly

explanation.surface: Fickle singers.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: warblers and thrushes are singers that take to the air.

clue.text: Dutch artist broadcast nonsense

indicators.note: something broadcast is heard rather than seen, so the word for nonsense is taken by its sound

parts.note: bosh is a dated word for nonsense

explanation.surface: A Dutch painter's work is dismissed on air as rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Hieronymus Bosch was a Netherlandish painter famous for fantastical scenes.

clue.text: I will occupy seat — seat of government

indicators.note: the letter I sits within the seat word, occupying it

parts.note: a sofa is a long upholstered seat

explanation.surface: Someone vows to take a seat in government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I will occupy seat' puts I in SOFA; the other 'seat' is in the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Sofia is the capital of Bulgaria, where its government sits.

clue.text: Secures wild places

definitions.meaning: ties up a boat, fastens it in place

explanation.surface: A double definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to make a boat fast at a berth, and stretches of rough upland heath.

clue.text: Naughty affairs bothered like-minded people

indicators.note: naughty means misbehaving, so the letters misbehave and fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Scandalous affairs troubled people who think alike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bothered' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'Naughty' is the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: people of similar tastes or character, from the proverb about flocking together.

clue.text: Like ancient oracle, I'd help confused Corinthian leader

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so these letters are jumbled
only the first letter of Corinthian, its leader, is used

explanation.surface: An ancient Corinthian leader seeks help from the oracle, but it baffles him.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective relation: the most famous ancient Greek oracle was at Delphi, and its sayings were notoriously ambiguous.

clue.text: Fool accepts certain guarantees

indicators.note: the fool takes in the certain word, holding it inside

parts.note: an ass is a fool
sure means certain

explanation.surface: An idiot takes on some sure-fire guarantees.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to promise someone confidently is to guarantee.
